title: AWS Production Reliability
intent: Technology + problem: proving reliability of workloads running on AWS
brief: What must be re-proven on AWS specifically: zonal and regional failure behaviour, control-plane dependency, quota headroom, recovery exercises, backup restore. Not a list of AWS services offered.

title: Azure Production Reliability
intent: Technology + problem: proving reliability of workloads running on Azure
brief: What must be re-proven on Azure specifically: availability zone coverage by region and service, paired-region assumptions, platform maintenance, identity dependency, recovery exercises. Distinct from the AWS page in substance.

title: Google Cloud Production Reliability
intent: Technology + problem: proving reliability of workloads running on Google Cloud
brief: What must be re-proven on Google Cloud specifically: global control-plane and global resource dependency, regional isolation, quota and policy propagation, recovery exercises. Distinct from AWS and Azure pages in substance.

title: Azure AI Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: assurance for AI workloads built on Microsoft's AI platform and Azure OpenAI models
brief: Deployment type, model retirement and automatic upgrade policy, quota and provisioned capacity, content safety configuration and agent identity each create evidence that expires. Use current Microsoft product names from research.

title: Amazon Bedrock Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: assurance for AI workloads built on Amazon Bedrock
brief: Model lifecycle states, cross-region inference routing, guardrail configuration, knowledge base synchronisation and agent runtime permissions each create evidence that expires. Use current AWS product names from research.

title: Vertex AI Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: assurance for AI workloads built on Google Cloud's AI platform and Gemini models
brief: Model version lifecycle and retirement dates, auto-updated aliases, agent runtime, grounding sources and throughput commitments each create evidence that expires. Confirm the platform's current name from research and state it accurately.

title: Microsoft Entra ID Exposure Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving Entra ID controls still enforce intended access
brief: Conditional Access exclusions, standing directory roles, guest lifecycle, application credentials and legacy retirement dates. What effective enforcement looks like and how it drifts in a real tenant.

title: AWS IAM Exposure Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving AWS identity and access remains least-privilege
brief: Long-lived access keys, unused roles and permissions, cross-account trust, root governance and organisation policy coverage. Distinct from the Entra page: AWS exposure is policy and trust-relationship centred.
